Figure 1: Conceptual diagram illustrating the dynamic time warping (DTW) distance metric. The cost calculation combines exact matches for event types (Kronecker delta behavior) with a probabilistic similarity measure for diagnoses, defined as 1 − max(p(da | db), p(db | da)). This enables the alignment of trajectories based on shared comorbidity patterns even when specific codes differ.
